description_en: Queries the disabled route entry of an Express Connect Router (ECR)
description_zh: 查询专线网关ECR（Express Connect Router）禁用的路由条目
name: DescribeDisabledExpressConnectRouterRouteEntries

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Express Connect Router (ECR)
parameters.name: ecr_id

parameters.help_en:
The token for the next query. Valid values:

If this is the first query or no next query is required, you do not need to specify this parameter.
If a next query is required, set the value to the NextToken value returned by the previous API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：

第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次 API 调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return. Valid values: 1 to 2147483647. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 本次读取的最大数据量。取值范围：1～2147483647。默认值为10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the request is a dry run. Valid values:

true: performs a dry run on the request without modifying the EPS resources.

false (default): sends a normal request
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会修改服务资源。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can generate the parameter value from your client to ensure that the value is unique across different requests. The ClientToken parameter supports only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request is unique
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The details about the access denial

Code.description_en: The status code. A value of 200 indicates that the call was successful. Other values indicate that the call failed. For more information about the causes of failure, see error codes
Code.description_zh: 判断调用是否成功。返回值为 200 表示加载成功，返回其他值表示加载失败，失败原因参见错误码

DisabledRouteEntryList.description_en: The list of queried route entries

DestinationCidrBlock.description_en: The destination CIDR block of the route entry

EcrId.description_en: The instance ID of the Express Connect Router (ECR)

GmtCreate.description_en: The time when the route entry was created

NexthopInstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the next hop

NexthopInstanceRegionId.description_en: The region ID of the next hop instance
NexthopInstanceRegionId.description_zh: 下一跳实例所属的地域ID

DynamicMessage.description_en:
The dynamic error message, which is used to replace `%s` in the ErrMessage error message.

If ErrMessage returns The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid and DynamicMessage returns DtsInstanceId, it indicates that the DtsInstanceId request parameter is invalid
DynamicMessage.description_zh:
动态错误信息，用于替换返回参数ErrMessage错误信息中的`%s`。

如果ErrMessage返回The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid，且DynamicMessage返回DtsInstanceId，则代表所传入的请求参数DtsInstanceId不合法
DynamicMessage.example: The param format of EcrId **** is illegal.

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries to return. Valid values: 1 to 2147483647. Default value: 10
MaxResults.description_zh: 本次读取的最大数据量。取值范围：1～2147483647。默认值为10

Message.description_en: The message returned by the operation

NextToken.description_en:
The token for the next query. Valid values:

If NextToken is empty, no next query is required.
If NextToken is returned, the value indicates the token for the next query
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：

如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the disabled Express Connect Router (ECR) routing is successfully queried. Valid values:
True: The query was successful.
False: The query failed
Success.description_zh:
查询禁用专线网关路由是否成功。取值：
True：成功。
False：失败

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of route entry
